title: Post-Promotional Interest Base: Charges Left Out of Principal (Home Comfort Financing)
content:
**Rule.** On a Home Comfort Financing account, the post-promotional interest base leaves out charges that are not principal: where the most recent payment on the account was returned, the base is the account balance less the most recent interest charge and less every late fee and returned-payment fee posted less than one whole month before the date of handling; where the most recent payment was not returned and such fees were posted in that month, the base is the account balance less those fees; otherwise the base is the account balance. A base below zero counts as zero.

**Terms used.**

- *The most recent payment was returned* — the account has a returned-payment entry dated on or after the posting date of its most recent payment.
- *The most recent interest charge* — the amount of the latest interest line on the account; where no interest charge has ever posted, nothing is taken off for it.
- *Fees posted in that month* — every late fee and every returned-payment fee posted less than one whole month before the date of handling.

## Decision diagram

```
Was the most recent payment returned?
 ├─ yes → the base is the account balance, less the most recent interest charge,
 │         less the late fees and returned-payment fees of the last month
 └─ no  → Were late fees or returned-payment fees posted in the last month?
           ├─ yes → the base is the account balance, less those fees
           └─ no  → the base is the account balance as it stands
In every branch, a result below zero counts as zero.
```

## Worked cases (hypothetical accounts, balance $2480.00 on the posting day)

| Records | Base |
|---|---|
| Most recent payment returned; in the last month a $25.00 late fee and a $15.00 returned-payment fee; most recent interest charge $35.49 | $2480.00 less $35.49, less $25.00, less $15.00: $2404.51 |
| Most recent payment not returned; a $25.00 late fee in the last month | $2480.00 less $25.00: $2455.00 |
| Most recent payment not returned; no late fee or returned-payment fee in the last month | $2480.00 |

A late fee posted five weeks before the date of handling is more than one whole month old and is not left out.
